svg.title: Iskra and Szlif — paired interaction vignette
svg.desc: Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
svg.title: Szlif — master raven vector (direction A selected and refined)
svg.desc: Szlif the raven, selected master. Angular construction: a heavy straight ochre bill with a down hook and a thin mandible line, a wedge head tilted down with a low brow over a small eye, three slim crest feathers raked back over the nape, a short throat hackle, a shouldered body tapering to a narrow rump, a broad slate folded wing with three wide separated primary feathers breaking the back outline, an open four-point fanned tail, two ochre legs with a bent knee and splayed toes, and a small turquoise plan notebook held in a talon. Flat vector, five colours, twenty-two named paths.
svg.title: Iskra — master fox vector (direction A selected and refined)
svg.desc: Iskra the fox, selected master. Soft-round construction: an upright torso with a wide chest and a tucked waist carried on two articulated legs with a bent knee and a cream sock on each shin, a broad tail sweeping up from the rump with a cream tip, a rounded head with a narrow projecting muzzle and cream jaw, a rust fringe lock rooted on the crown that sweeps diagonally across the far eye and flicks out over the cheek, a turquoise scarf wrapped round the neck with a bulky knot at the throat and a wide end flying behind the head, and one arm with a real shoulder holding a large turquoise plan sheet. Flat vector, five colours, twenty-two named paths.
